## Decouple decode buffer bound from the wire cap

Follow-up to the streaming work. The decoder currently rejects frames using `MAX_FRAME_PAYLOAD`, but that constant is really about the wire contract; the decoder's own concern is how big a single allocation it is willing to make. This introduces a local `MAX_DECODE_BUFFER` for that and checks against it, so later changes to the wire cap don't accidentally change the decoder's allocation behaviour.

No change to the happy path: valid frames decode exactly as before.

### Tests
Existing `decode_frame` tests pass (round-trip of a small frame, short-header and short-payload errors).

    cargo test decode
